Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you a clean comparison for procurement: 

Recap:
- Current use case: real-time agent responses + nightly batch embeddings for analytics.
- Expected ramp: 100M tokens/month in Q2, target ~300-500M tokens/month by Q4 if performance/latency checks out.
- Priority: predictable unit economics (target cost bucket around $X-$Y per 1M tokens), procurement prefers marketplace private offer flow (AWS Marketplace preferred).

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the procurement path (AWS Marketplace private offer vs GCP/Azure)? You mentioned AWS but want to be explicit for our ops.
2) Can you give a target $/1M tokens or a budget range you need us to hit for internal approval? If you can provide an expected monthly committed spend range that helps map the private offer pricing.
3) Please loop in the procurement contact if someone else should own PO/contract.

Next steps from our side: we’ll produce a short sheet mapping Redwood hosted list price vs. expected marketplace private offer unit price for AWS/GCP/Azure (including marketplace fees and any margin adjustments), and outline setup lead times & required docs. Thanks Marissa — great demo. Quick answers below.

1) Procurement path: AWS Marketplace private offer is preferred. We also have a GCP procurement lane but AWS is primary.

2) Budget/target $/1M tokens: Our internal target range is roughly $80–$130 per 1M tokens for inference+embeddings combined (this is what finance will sign off on for committed volume). If you can get to the low end with a multi-quarter commit we can move fast.

3) Procurement contacts: forwarding procurement team on this thread (procurement@insightapp.com). Our procurement lead is Dana West (dana.west@insightapp.com).

Estimated volume: planning 100M tokens/month starting April, scaling to ~350M by November. We can consider a 6–12 month committed private offer if terms look good.

Let us know what you need from procurement to start the private offer process (SOW, PO template, DPA, SOC 2 evidence).

Appreciate it — Alex

Marissa — quick pass below (I’ll update the spreadsheet and share link):

Preliminary unit price mapping (ballpark per 1M tokens):
- Redwood hosted (list): $200 per 1M tokens (baseline for our hosted API tiers).
- AWS Marketplace private offer: ~ $170 per 1M tokens (assumes 15% marketplace fee + 10% transaction/settlement uplift we bake into the MPO price). With a committed 12-month volume at 350M/mo we can structure a tiered discount to approach ~$120 per 1M.
- GCP Marketplace private offer: ~ $175 per 1M tokens (GCP fee structure similar but different payout timing; may need slightly higher MPO price to cover billing timing risk).
- Azure Marketplace private offer: ~ $180 per 1M tokens (Azure's marketing/transaction fees and position require slightly higher cover).

Notes / caveats:
- These assume standard precision models (no heavy custom fine-tuning) and standard KV cache hit rates. If they need guaranteed low-latency dedicated pools or GPU isolation, price will increase.
- Embedding-heavy batches lower effective $/1M tokens; we should model their workload mix (inference vs embeddings) for final pricing.
- Lead time for MPO setup on AWS: typically 4–6 weeks once procurement returns signed MPO template + SOW. GCP/Azure similar but variable (GCP sometimes 6–8 weeks).

Action items I’ll complete by EOD: populate the spreadsheet with the numbers above, add a column showing incremental discount thresholds (3mo / 6mo / 12mo commits), and attach the SOC 2 and DPA links.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
